```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
library(ggpubr)
library("DGEobj.utils")
setwd("/Users/magalhae/Desktop/FANCY_DNAcaller/FANCI_DNAseq_T2T_CHM3/NPKL_SAD_genes/counts")
```

```{r}
NPKL_RNA_quant <- read_tsv("/Users/magalhae/Desktop/FANCY_DNAcaller/FANCI_DNAseq_T2T_CHM3/NPKL_SAD_genes/counts/chm13.draft_v2.0.gene.counts.tsv") %>% column_to_rownames('Geneid')

```
```{r}
keepCol = c('NPKL_RNA_FANCI_rep2', 'NPKL_RNA_FANCI_rep4', 'NPKL_RNA_FANCI_rep5', 'NPKL_RNA_Input_rep2', 'NPKL_RNA_Input_rep4', 'NPKL_RNA_Input_rep5')
countsMatrix = as.matrix(NPKL_RNA_quant[keepCol])
geneLength = NPKL_RNA_quant$Length
NPKL_RNA_quant_TPM <- convertCounts(
  countsMatrix,
  unit = "tpm",
  geneLength,
  log = FALSE,
  normalize = "none",
  prior.count = NULL
)
NPKL_RNA_quant_TPM = as_tibble(NPKL_RNA_quant_TPM, rownames = "Geneid")
write_csv(NPKL_RNA_quant_TPM, file = "NPKL_RNA_quant_TPM.csv")
```

```{r}
df <- read_csv("/Users/magalhae/Desktop/FANCY_DNAcaller/FANCI_DNAseq_T2T_CHM3/NPKL_SAD_genes/Gene_cov_analysis_masterDF.csv")
```
```{r}
df2 = df
df2 <- filter(df, NPKL_RNA_FANCI > 0)
df2 <- filter(df2, NPKL_DNA_FANCI_sum > 0 )
df2 <- filter(df2, !gene_biotype == 'scRNA' )
df2 <- filter(df2, !gene_biotype == 'scaRNA' )
df2 <- filter(df2, !gene_biotype == 'miRNA' )
df2 <- filter(df2, !gene_biotype == 'sRNA' )
df2 <- filter(df2, !seq_id == 'chrX')
df2 <- filter(df2, !seq_id == 'chrM')
df2 <- filter(df2, !seq_id == 'chrY')
```

```{r}
df2 <- arrange(df2, desc(NPKL_DNA_FANCI_max)) %>%
          mutate(NPKL_DNA_FANCI_max_rank = 1:nrow(df2))

df2 <- arrange(df2, desc(NPKL_RNA_FANCI)) %>%
          mutate(NPKL_RNA_FANCI_rank = 1:nrow(df2))

df2 <- arrange(df2, desc(NPKL_RNA_Input)) %>%
          mutate(NPKL_RNA_Input_rank = 1:nrow(df2))
```


```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=12}
graph <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = log2NPKL_RNA_FANCI, y = log2NPKL_DNA_FANCI_mean, color = Type)) +
  #geom_hdr() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid( . ~ gene_biotype, scales = "free") +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  theme_bw()
graph
```
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=12}
graph <- df2 %>% filter(Type == 'Other' ) %>% ggplot(aes(y = log2NPKL_RNA_FANCI, x = log2NPKL_RNA_Input, color = Type)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid( . ~ gene_biotype, scales = "free") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x+0) +
  stat_regline_equation(label.x=7, label.y=4) + 
  stat_cor(aes(label=..rr.label..), label.x=7, label.y=3) + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  xlim(0,15) + ylim(0,15) + 
  theme_bw()
graph
```

```{r}
# The code below will generate the graph:

# Identify the top 10 hits
Top_Hits = head(arrange(df2,NPKL_RNA_FANCI_rank),10)

graph <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = NPKL_RNA_FANCI_rank, y = log2NPKL_RNA_FANCI, colour = Type)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(data = Top_Hits, aes(label = Name)) + 
  theme_bw()
graph

# If you would like to save your graph, you can use:
ggsave('Ranking_all.pdf', graph, width = 14, height = 14, units = 'cm')
```
